atlas_info.description: Functional neuroanatomy mapping for somatic BCI alignment and neurochemical regulation.

Prefrontal_Cortex.functional_role: Executive cognitive control, logic puzzles, goal-directed behavior, and decision making.

Hypothalamus.functional_role: Central endocrine regulator, metabolic homeostasis, suprachiasmatic nucleus circadian control, and hormone synthesis.

Thalamus.functional_role: Sensory gatekeeper, routing external signals (auditory/tactile) to cortex, modulating EEG rhythm generators (Alpha waves).

Hippocampus.functional_role: Memory consolidation, spatial navigation mapping, and reality grounding.

Amygdala.functional_role: Emotional threat detection, fear conditioning, and autonomic stress responses.
